about: Sherlock's UI actions (P6U-04, P6U-05): the one list that both the server's tool definitions and the browser's registry use. They run in the asking person's console window and change only that person's view; open_tool_dialog opens a dialog the person reads and sends, never a session (TB-42). Edit here; the browser imports this file.

actions.name: view_state
actions.description: Reads the person's console view as it is now: the tab and path, its filters, each table on screen (its id, search text, sort, shown and hidden columns, rows shown against rows in the table, the names of the first rows shown) and the open details pane. The view when the question was asked is already attached to it; call this after changing the view, or when the person may have moved.

actions.name: view_open
actions.description: Opens a tab of the cluster the person is on, with an optional path and filters, replacing the filters there. Tabs: alerts, nodes, fleets, namespaces (path: [namespace]), pods, helm (path: [namespace, release]), services, networks, access, policies (path: [section]). The filters each tab accepts are those view_filter accepts. It cannot open another cluster: for that, give the person a link instead.

path.description: The tab's path, such as ["web"] for the namespace web or ["web", "shop"] for a Helm release.

cluster.description: Only the cluster the person is on; any other is refused with a link to offer instead.

actions.name: view_filter
actions.description: Changes the filters of the tab the person is on. Nodes: role (all, control-plane, worker), err (all; problems: the nodes with an error or a warning; errors: only the nodes with an error, such as NotReady, not reporting, network unavailable, or pods failing on them), label and taint (lists). Pods: role, status (all, running: running and ready, notready: running but not ready, pending, failing, completed), ns and node (lists of names), label, taint. Services: ns, type (all, ClusterIP, Headless, NodePort, LoadBalancer, notReady). Namespaces: kinds (list of object kinds). Alerts: kind (all, pods, nodes, volumes), show (active, all), acked (show, hide: hide the acknowledged ones), by (node: each pod under the node it runs on, the default; kind: pods, nodes and volumes apart). Fleets: fleet, pl, pt (lists), group (fleet, none), err (all, problems, errors, as on Nodes). Helm: tab (pods, workloads, storage, network, other, values, notes, history). Storage: ns, node and class (lists of names; (no-claim), (no-node) and (no-class) for the rows with none), attention ("1" for the rows that need attention), label (list of key=value). Access: kind (all, users, groups, sas), verb, res, wns, tbl (bindings, roles), sys and defaults ("1" or ""). Search text has its own action, view_search.

set.description: Filters to set, replacing their values.

add.description: Values to add to list filters.

clear.description: Filters to clear; ["*"] clears them all.

actions.name: view_search
actions.description: Sets or clears the search text of a table on screen, which shows only the rows that contain every word. Without a table, the tab's main search box.

table.description: The table's id from the view state.

text.description: The search text; empty clears it.

actions.name: view_sort
actions.description: Sorts a table on screen by one of its columns.

table.description: The table's id from the view state; without it, the tab's first table.

column.description: A column id of that table, from the view state.

actions.name: view_columns
actions.description: Shows or hides columns of a table on screen until the page reloads; the person's saved column choices stay as they were.

table.description: The table's id from the view state; without it, the tab's first table.

actions.name: view_details
actions.description: Opens the details pane of an object over the page, as clicking its link does, or closes it. Kinds: Node, Pod, Service, and namespaced objects such as Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, Job, CronJob, Ingress, PersistentVolumeClaim, ConfigMap, Secret (key names only).

namespace.description: Its namespace, for a namespaced object.

actions.name: view_highlight
actions.description: Scrolls a row of a table on screen into view and marks it for a few seconds. Use it in the view as it is: never widen a filtered view to highlight a row among the others.

table.description: The table's id from the view state; without it, the tab's first table.

row.description: The row's name, as the view state lists it.

actions.name: open_tool_dialog
actions.description: Opens the dialog of a Toolbox tool, filled in, for the person to read, change and send: Shell, Port forward or Debug container for a pod; Node shell or Debug pod for a node. Nothing opens until the person presses the dialog's button; it never starts a session or types into one. Choose the tool the problem needs: a debug container for an image without a shell (distroless), a node shell for a node's problem, a debug pod with a pod's labels for a network question. Draft the reason from the alert or finding it came from.

namespace.description: The pod's namespace, or the debug pod's.

pod.description: The pod, for a pod's tool.

node.description: The node, for a node's tool or a debug pod.

container.description: The container to open the shell in, or the debug container's target.

port.description: The pod's port, for a port forward.

image.description: The image's name in the toolbox values (such as general or network), for a debug container or pod.

profile.description: A node shell's profile (general, netadmin, sysadmin), or a debug container's capabilities (general, restricted).

labelsFrom.description: For a debug pod: the pod whose labels it copies, so network policies treat it the same.

reason.description: A drafted reason, citing what it came from, for production and node tools.
